notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls a destructible nonblack creature.
description:
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Executioner's Capsule by paying {1}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, destroying target nonblack creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies, triggering Glissa and Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Glissa trigger, returning Executioner's Capsule from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Salvaging Station trigger, untapping it.
Cast Executioner's Capsule by paying {B}.
Repeat.
